shared_boundary: Candidate library only. No ranking, mandatory policy sequence, enabled follower or verified physical readiness. HLA owns semantics, inventory, goal choice, staging and independent final word verification. Snapshot handles are not persistent semantic identities.

tool_waypoint_v1.responsibility: Reach a caller TCP waypoint without intentionally moving a piece; startup approach, inspect/retract and between-contact reposition. Dataset tool_position.

selection_cues.actual_inputs: Current TCP/base pose and occupancy; goal_tcp_base differs from current pose and does not require target-piece displacement. Optional joint/tau guards and observed neighbor stability.
selection_cues.agent_judgment: A visible free corridor or escape direction, no unresolved jam, appropriate physical waypoint. Not selected solely because the arm is high or dq is large. No performance ranking.

entry_conditions.implemented: Matching model/policy ID, finite transforms/robot state, fresh t and camera ages, visible scene components, current protected-ID bindings when named, caller goal. New memory starts independent history.
entry_conditions.not_certified: Reachability, true noncontact, table/rod clearance, physical tip geometry, arm swept volumes, singularity and actual controller readiness.

continuation_conditions.implemented: Increasing fresh live samples, same fixed call signature, tracking gap <=.5s, accepted scene confidence, no changed neighbors, caller-supplied q/tau margins if present, timeout/stall/reset budgets.
continuation_conditions.agent_judgment: Inspect large measured joint-motion advisory, uncued obstacles, latent contact and clearance. CONTROLLER_UNVERIFIED means offline candidate, not permission to execute.

tool_waypoint_v1.exit_conditions: Three fresh accepted observations within enlarged spatial and angular tolerance; requested stop additionally needs actual last verified zero native command and measured |dq|<.03; pass-through does not require stopping. REACHED_LOCAL_GOAL also requires caller-verified plane and no uncertain neighbors. No word success claim; physical handoff remains unverified.

successor_readiness.returned: Achieved TCP base pose, pose/orientation error, phase, track confidence, changed/uncertain neighbors, symmetry and unvalidated command uncertainty, fresh-observation and achieved-local-geometry flags.
successor_readiness.agent_judgment: Reinspect precontact boundary or inspection pose before selecting a piece policy; decoder audit is a separate blocking dependency.

switch_procedure: Interrupt the current call; a null or zero candidate is not an executed stop.
Keep any suspended piece's desired fixed world footprint externally, not this tool model's history.
Acquire a fresh scene and verify the same physical instance, especially lookalike barred pieces.

Select a policy freely based on current goal and geometry. Re-express a goal if W changed. For a new piece entry footprint recompute SE2 or supply the retained goal_footprint_W rather than blindly reapplying an old displacement.
Use new call_id and memory=None, actual last_executed_action feedback and fresh bindings; never transfer neural or mode state.

failure_signatures.implemented: Stale/repeated views, lost scene tracks, unexpected neighbor displacement, supplied joint/tau guard violation, audited-mapping planar sweep collision, stall/reset budget and timeout.
failure_signatures.remaining_judgments: Tool wedging/contact, top-height error, arm collision, singularity, force interpretation and safe recovery. Large dq is advisory, not an invented fault diagnosis.

tool_waypoint_v1.memory_reset_rules: Reset on new call/waypoint/policy/frame, abort, >.5s observation gap or reacquisition. At most twelve causal records, four encoded snapshots; tracker persists only for the call. Same-memory changed signature is ABORTED. Do not transfer candidate output as actual command history.
tool_waypoint_v1.observation_dependencies: Dual original RGB, calibrated third K/dist/T_base_cam, calibrated wrist K/dist/T_flange_cam and T_base_flange, T_base_ee, q, measured dq, tau_ext, live t/sample and image ages/stamps. Gripper feedback masked when -1/NaN. W is board proxy unless actual measured top-plane calibration supplied; external fresh union mask optional. Physical mapping/guards are explicit optional audited inputs, not inferred assets.

training_evidence.meaning: Half-open intervals. Four sequences, 382 rows reused under piece goals, not four independent episodes. Startup wait/descent, lateral transit and lift/reconfiguration observed; contact-free eligibility weak. Coverage counts/geometry exclusions emitted per segment after preprocessing, no invented retained counts.

tool_waypoint_v1.limitations: No autonomous jam extraction, grasping, arbitrary crowded navigation, new-shape success or verified safety. Color/plane/rod/controller limitations are shared across priors. Decoder cannot be enabled by caller assertion. Physical clearance requests remain unverified; proxy route uses fixed .10m W TCP lift floor.

piece_contact_graph_v1.responsibility: Relocate/refine exactly one persistent planar physical instance to an explicit W footprint/SE2 objective, including internal approaches, strokes, resets and requested TCP exit. Dataset piece_relocation.

selection_cues.actual_inputs: Local outer/inner contour confidence, shape scale, proxy boundary proximity, obstacle masks, goal correspondence and native uncertainty diagnostics. Physical rod/plane confidence is separately provided.
selection_cues.agent_judgment: Prefer this representation when local boundaries and mechanics assumptions are credible. Candidate/response scores are unvalidated, not proof of contact or a learned success ranking. Dense field is an alternative when canonical angle/mechanics is doubtful but masks are sound.

entry_conditions.implemented: Valid fresh scene, unambiguous instance_seed_W within .06m and .008m alternative margin, persistent caller instance_id, compatible fixed SE2/footprint goal, protected binding resolution, finite robot state. Proxy contour candidates include holes.
entry_conditions.not_certified: True collision-feasible contact, reachability, rod fit inside a recess, flatness/rigidity, plane/top height, calibrated forces and controller readiness. Contact candidates are proxy-screened only.

continuation_conditions.implemented: Same call/instance/world goal, fresh causal images, confidence >=.25, no protected/nonselected motion beyond threshold, current actual-command history, accepted optional joint/tau guards and budgets. Histories never consume future targets.
continuation_conditions.agent_judgment: Unexpected rotation, repeated ineffective contact, tool wedging, tipping or coupled motion may require inspection even before a coded stall. Alternative policies do not bypass shared perception failures.

piece_contact_graph_v1.exit_conditions: Symmetric boundary error within max(caller tolerance,2*plane margin), requested exit TCP pose/orientation and arrival checks, optional fresh semantic directed-axis constraint, no uncertain neighbors, held for three fresh calls. REACHED_LOCAL_GOAL requires verified plane; it is local physical geometry, not recognized character/word success. Missing semantic upright cannot be inferred from a symmetric silhouette.

successor_readiness.returned: Current tool pose, contour/tool error, symmetry/proximity, track confidence, phase/reset count, changed/uncertain neighbors, achieved-local-geometry and proxy-goal/exit flags.
successor_readiness.implemented_ready_flags: Physical/hardware/safe-to-handoff all false because no verified follower/tool collision model is shipped.
successor_readiness.agent_judgment: Whether to refine this instance, move a blocker, inspect/reset tool or select the field alternative. Reacquire current footprint from inventory rather than trusting old endpoint labels.

switch_procedure: Save desired fixed goal footprint, instance identity and latest tool/neighbor diagnostics outside memory.
Interrupt and obtain actual current robot command/pose; do not equate candidate action with execution.
Reacquire the SAME physical instance from current geometry, resolving lookalike identity ambiguity before a new call.

For a tool reset choose a visible TCP waypoint; the suspended piece goal remains unchanged. On return or alternative-policy switch supply retained goal_footprint_W or a recomputed current-entry-to-world-goal SE2. Transform all goals/bindings if W changed.
Use a new call_id and memory=None; no response model state, hidden state or source segment index is transferred. There is no mandatory tool-then-graph sequence.

failure_signatures.implemented: Track confidence loss, stale/repeated data, neighbor displacement, goal/instance change under same memory, stalled contour improvement, too many inferred resets, optional robot guard violation or audited planar sweep block.
failure_signatures.remaining_judgments: Incorrect normal/inner-hole geometry, friction mismatch, inaccessible boundary, mask identity swaps not caught by confidence, unexpected rotation, force/contact state and complete jam recovery.

piece_contact_graph_v1.memory_reset_rules: New instance/goal/frame/policy or reacquisition resets response/mode/history state; persistent caller identity and world goal live externally. Cached twelve causal features use four recurrent snapshots. A >.5s gap requires new acquisition. Do not warm from another policy's predictions; use actual live history/commands only.
piece_contact_graph_v1.observation_dependencies: Same calibrated dual-view RGB/robot state as tool prior plus current selected track/obstacles and caller physical goal. Color segmentation/causal rigid tracking are shipped; no pretrained open-world recognizer, verified mask annotation, metric depth, physical rod geometry or kinematic model is assumed. Fresh external union mask and measured W can be supplied through executable converters. Semantic upright axes/hypotheses must be actual upstream live observations.

training_evidence.meaning: 22 half-open invocations with original context buffers. Wedge, barred clearance/staging, ring correction, R staging/retrieval and B reset, D inner-opening pushes/alignment, L off-center reversals/recontacts and final withdrawal/actual zero holds. Same source as field policy, independent weights. No contact/success annotation. Weak endpoint/response eligibility and any unsupported segment are published by full preprocessing.

piece_contact_graph_v1.limitations: One-step proxy mechanics and bounded learned residuals, not a calibrated friction/QP planner. Tracking, physical plane, rod sweep, semantic recognition and controller deficits remain. No tested recovery ranking or novel-shape generalization. Uncertain object goals retain endpoint-tool-conditioned action imitation with missing-goal flags, rather than pretending audited piece intent.

piece_goal_field_v1.responsibility: Independent dense current-to-goal geometry servo for one persistent flat piece, including contact acquisition, nonmonotonic correction/reset and optional tool exit. Dataset piece_relocation.

selection_cues.actual_inputs: Reliable selected/goal masks and correspondence, symmetry ambiguity, proxy contour error and native uncertainty. Dense local SDF and whole-scene occupancy remain available when unique canonical yaw is not.
selection_cues.agent_judgment: Consider for silhouette refinement or uncertain local mechanics, not because of an invented superiority score. Stop/reacquire if masks or identity are unreliable; this shares the graph policy's perception and cannot serve as independent safety redundancy.

entry_conditions.implemented: Fresh paired views and robot state, unambiguous current seed/persistent instance_id, fixed compatible W footprint/SE2, binding checks, current goal/map conversion and valid call/model ID.
entry_conditions.not_certified: Planar rigid object assumption, semantic orientation, rod sweep/height, full geometric safety projection, reachability and physical controller. No canonical pose or alphabet template is required.

continuation_conditions.implemented: Same physical instance/goal signature, fresh observation and four-snapshot masked history, adequate tracking, no changed nonselected instances, budget/guard checks. Endpoint goals and future motion exist only in training labels.
continuation_conditions.agent_judgment: Unstable correspondence, action inefficacy at unfamiliar concavities, mask swaps and coupled motion may require earlier intervention. Geometric proximity is not contact force.

piece_goal_field_v1.exit_conditions: Three fresh accepted contour-tolerance observations, requested exit and actual-stop/pass-through checks, optional live semantic-axis constraint, no uncertain neighbors and caller-verified plane for REACHED_LOCAL_GOAL. Mask alignment alone is not spelling acceptance. Decoder and physical handoff still unverified.

successor_readiness.returned: Contour/tool errors, symmetry/proxy proximity, mode, track confidence, native unvalidated uncertainty, neighbor changes and goal/exit satisfaction flags; current geometry can be reacquired through inventory.
successor_readiness.agent_judgment: Choose refinement, alternative graph representation, tool reset, obstacle-clearing goal or inspection based on current physical evidence; no mandatory sequence.

switch_procedure: Save fixed desired world footprint and persistent identity, along with latest changed-neighbor diagnostics.
Interrupt and reacquire current actual robot/scene state rather than advancing a prerecorded sequence.
Resolve the SAME physical instance in a fresh inventory; if identity is ambiguous return uncertainty.
Preserve goal_footprint_W or recompute SE2 relative to the new entry footprint; transform it and all seeds if W changes. Do not replay an old relative displacement after a reset.
Select graph/tool/field as appropriate with a new call_id, memory=None and actual last-command feedback. Never transfer field recurrence or a source index to another policy.

failure_signatures.implemented: Stale/repeated images, tracking confidence loss, invalid goal silhouette/binding, changed neighbors, contour-error stall/reset/timeout, supplied joint/tau alarm and audited-intent planar collision.
failure_signatures.remaining_judgments: Correspondence sign/shape errors, unexpected rotations, ineffective pushes, missing semantic upright, shape tipping/stacking, hidden obstacle or jam. No calibrated success probability or force estimate exists.

piece_goal_field_v1.memory_reset_rules: Reset on changed policy/call/goal/instance/frame, tracking gap/loss and explicit abort. Keep desired geometry/identity externally; at most twelve cached records and four recurrent snapshots belong to this call. Reinitialize maps with actual current observations, not future targets or another policy's recurrent state.
piece_goal_field_v1.observation_dependencies: Original calibrated third/wrist RGB and full robot transforms/state/timing; selected shape/obstacle geometry via executable color tracker or fresh external union mask; explicit W goal and optional base TCP exit. No endpoint/frame/source ID online. Plane and rod calibration, physical intent map, robot guards and semantic live axes are independent assets requiring truthful caller provenance. Gripper/depth missingness is not imputed as valid contact evidence.

training_evidence.meaning: Same 22 frozen invocation intervals/context as graph, independently trained. Ring/symmetric goals, D/recess interactions, L reversals, R reset, blocked-space clearance, nonzero angular and terminal zero actions all retained as action support. Missing geometry/endpoint/motion eligibility is reported per segment and phase, not hidden; no verified contact, semantic or success labels.

piece_goal_field_v1.limitations: Dense servo may propose ineffective contacts despite proxy screening. 64-square native local maps preserve metric scale but small holes can be lost by foreground morphology; coarse global map lacks full collision resolution. Shared calibration/segmentation errors correlate alternatives. Novel colors/physical shapes/words and combined generalization are required tests, not demonstrated results. Decoder and physical readiness remain disabled; external semantic hypotheses are an explicit autonomy dependency.
